strands.name: Strand A: Mathematical Thinking and Making Connections

overalls.title: Mathematical Processes
overalls.description: apply the mathematical processes to develop a conceptual understanding of, and procedural fluency with, the mathematics they are learning

specifics.description: I can apply problem-solving strategies and mathematical processes to develop fluency and deepen my understanding.
I can make connections between mathematics and real-life situations, various knowledge systems, and career applications.

overalls.title: Number Sets and Development
overalls.description: demonstrate an understanding of the development and use of numbers, and make connections between sets of numbers

specifics.description: I can describe the development of number concepts across cultures and explain relationships between subsets of numbers.

overalls.title: Powers and Exponents
overalls.description: represent numbers in various ways, evaluate powers, and simplify expressions by using the relationships between powers and their exponents

specifics.description: I can evaluate powers, express numbers in scientific notation, and simplify expressions using exponent laws.

overalls.title: Rational Numbers, Ratios, Rates, and Proportions
overalls.description: apply an understanding of rational numbers, ratios, rates, percentages, and proportions, in various mathematical contexts, and to solve problems

specifics.description: I can apply integers to describe direction, amount, and change in various contexts.
I can solve problems involving fractions, ratios, rates, percentages, and proportions in real-life contexts.
I can use positive and negative fractions and mixed numbers to solve problems involving formulas, measurements, and linear relations.

overalls.title: Algebraic Concepts and Expressions
overalls.description: demonstrate an understanding of the development and use of algebraic concepts and of their connection to numbers, using various tools and representations

specifics.description: I can create, simplify, and compare algebraic expressions and solve equations for various contexts.

overalls.title: Coding and Algebraic Concepts
overalls.description: apply coding skills to represent mathematical concepts and relationships dynamically, and to solve problems, in algebra and across the other strands

specifics.description: I can use coding to demonstrate understanding of algebraic concepts and to solve problems.

overalls.title: Linear and Non-Linear Relations
overalls.description: represent and compare linear and non-linear relations that model real-life situations, and use these representations to make predictions

specifics.description: I can represent linear relations in multiple ways and connect rates of change and initial values to graphs and equations.
I can compare two linear relations and interpret the meaning of their intersection point in a given context.

overalls.title: Characteristics of Relations
overalls.description: demonstrate an understanding of the characteristics of various representations of linear and non-linear relations, using tools, including coding when appropriate

specifics.description: I can compare characteristics of linear and non-linear relations across graphs, tables, and equations, and use coding to model algebraic concepts.

overalls.title: Data Collection and Analysis
overalls.description: describe the collection and use of data, and represent and analyse data involving one and two variables

specifics.description: I can represent and analyse data using scatter plots, box plots, quartiles, and regression models to make predictions.
I can describe the implications of collecting, storing, and using large amounts of data.

overalls.title: Mathematical Modelling
overalls.description: apply the process of mathematical modelling, using data and mathematical concepts from other strands, to represent, analyse, make predictions, and provide insight into real-life situations

specifics.description: I can describe the value of mathematical modelling and how it informs real-life decisions.
I can design a data collection plan, build a mathematical model, and report on how the model answers a question of interest, including its limitations.
I can display and analyse data to create a model that addresses an original question, accounting for assumptions and context.

overalls.title: Geometric and Measurement Relationships
overalls.description: demonstrate an understanding of the development and use of geometric and measurement relationships, and apply these relationships to solve problems, including problems involving real-life situations

specifics.description: I can research the development of geometric or measurement concepts across cultures and describe their relevance to careers.
I can solve problems involving perimeter, area, surface area, volume, and the Pythagorean theorem in real-life contexts.
I can explain how changing dimensions affects perimeter, area, surface area, and volume.
I can create and analyse designs using geometric relationships and circle and triangle properties.
I can solve problems involving the volume relationships between prisms and pyramids, and cylinders and cones.

overalls.title: Financial Decisions
overalls.description: demonstrate the knowledge and skills needed to make informed financial decisions

specifics.description: I can analyse financial situations involving appreciation, depreciation, interest rates, and budgets to make informed financial decisions.
I can modify budgets to reflect changing circumstances and explain the rationale for my modifications.
I can compare the effects of different interest rates, loan terms, and down payments on the overall cost of purchases.
I can use graphs to answer questions related to appreciation and depreciation in financial contexts.
I can identify past or current financial situations and explain how they inform financial decision-making.
